assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness accompanied by a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks and known sick sinus syndrome.
The service is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity or conduction abnormalities that may not be captured on standard ambulatory monitoring.
The service is medically necessary to evaluate the patient's recurrent dizziness and giddiness in the context of the documented sick sinus syndrome and transient cerebral ischemic attacks.
